pixel_coordinates: Origin at top-left; x right, y down; fingertip is the top-center of the index-finger outline.
pivot_coordinates: Origin at bottom-left; x right, y up; pivot equals fingertip: x_px/width, 1-y_px/height.
canvas: Both frames use the same transparent 256x360 canvas and fingertip anchor.
press_scale: Uniform 0.92 image scale relative to normal, plus a slight distal index-finger bend.

prompts.normal: Dorsal-view tutorial hand; visible index nail and knuckles, three curled fingers, side thumb, light ivory skin, teal cuff, thick navy outline, soft shading, glossy casual mobile-game style, transparent background.
prompts.press: Edit the same hand: preserve identity, dorsal view, colors and shading; gently bend only the index fingertip for a tap. Export at 92% scale.
